'''Nirnroot''' is a bright green plant normally found growing near water. Nirnroot plants glow, making them easier to locate at night, and also emit a unique chiming sound. While in-game text claims Nirnroot does not regrow, it actually does regrow normally like other plants (unlike its behavior in ''[[Oblivion:Nirnroot|Oblivion]]''). A related plant is [[Skyrim:Crimson Nirnroot|Crimson Nirnroot]], which has nearly identical alchemical properties, with only certain differences in the Damage Health and Damage Stamina effects. Nirnroot and Crimson Nirnroot can be combined to make a four-effect potion, as shown [[#4 Effects|below]].

[[Skyrim:Damage Health|Damage Health]] poisons made using Nirnroot have the same strength as those made using standard Damage Health ingredients. However, the gold value of such poisons is 12.6 times greater than those made using standard ingredients. See the effect page for details.

==Combinations==
In terms of combinations of two ingredients, Nirnroot can be combined with 63 other ingredients.

==Ingredients==
22 guaranteed samples can be found in 19 different locations. Locations with multiple samples are:
* 3 on an island north of [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] ([[Skyrim:The Pale|The Pale]])
* 2 in [[Skyrim:Angeline's Aromatics|Angeline's Aromatics]] ([[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]])
* 2 in [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]] ([[Skyrim:The Rift|The Rift]])
* 2 in [[Skyrim:Sinderion's Field Laboratory|Sinderion's Field Laboratory]] ([[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]])
It is categorized as a rare ingredient, meaning that most apothecary merchants have a 21% chance of carrying 1-4 samples. In addition, it may be randomly found only in rare-type [[Skyrim:Apothecary's Satchel|apothecary's satchels]]. Other possible locations for already-harvested samples include:
* 1-2 guaranteed samples are found on several dead [[Skyrim:Alchemist|alchemists]], including the one found at [[Skyrim:Clearpine Pond|Clearpine Pond]].

==Related Quests==
* {{Quest Link|Few and Far Between}}
** 20 samples are needed for this quest.

==Notes==
* Nirnroot can be sold to [[Skyrim:Avrusa Sarethi|Avrusa Sarethi]] at [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]] for the quest [[Skyrim:Gather Wheat|Gather Wheat]] for 10 gold each.
* Nirnroot and Crimson Nirnroot are not affected by the [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] perk [[Skyrim:Green Thumb|Green Thumb]]; therefore, even with the perk, you will still only collect a single sample from each plant. However, with the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on installed, several regular Nirnroot plants can be found in [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]] which yield multiple samples of the ingredient.
* With the [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] add-on, you cannot plant Nirnroot at the [[Skyrim:Greenhouse|greenhouse or garden]] of your [[Skyrim:Construction|player-built property]].
* Although [[Skyrim:Gianna|Gianna]] claims during the quest [[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|To Kill an Empire]] that Nirnroot can be added to soups as "a special seasoning", you cannot do this yourself when cooking.
